title: OP_GETIDX0 stores a Hash result through a regs pointer taken before a default proc grew the VM stack
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 13e017c2f (13e017c2f81d3a3b69e042c75994f4f5cf684e41) (2026-08-09), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: heap-use-after-free (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
